title: BusinessCase
description: CEO-facing business case for a single action code, expressing EUR impact, time-to-effect and confidence.

action_code_id.description: ID of the action code this business case belongs to (must exist in core/action_codes/).

kpi_id.description: Primary outcome KPI id that this business case tracks (must exist in KPI catalog).

impact_range_eur_min.description: Conservative lower-bound annual EUR impact (pessimistic scenario).

time_to_effect_days.description: Expected calendar days from action trigger to measurable KPI improvement.

confidence.description: Confidence level in the EUR range, based on quality of evidence.

evidence_source_url.description: URL to the primary evidence source (internal report, McKinsey, Gartner, etc.). Optional.

owner.description: Accountable business role for this business case (e.g. CFO, VP Commercial).

assumptions.description: Explicit list of assumptions underpinning the EUR range.
